description: Ambient Photonics has developed a novel dye sensitized solar cell technology to efficiently harvest indoor ambient light Ambient cells have 3x the power density of amorphous silicon cells, enabling IoT devices (e.g. remote controls, security cameras) to be powered with renewable energy Electronics’ current dependence on batteries drives frustrating customer experiences and risks potentially critical gaps in commercial settings Ambient’s technology has a 80% smaller GHG footprint than batteries

AMP developed a platform of hardware and software solution for managing batteries in vehicles and stationary energy storage systems Electric vehicle sales will account for roughly 32% of total market share for new cars by 2030 AMP solutions meet a growing need for advanced battery controls that are cost effective and improve performance The company combines software and hardware solutions that leverage the cloud to provide a dynamic, real-time, optimized energy management solution Customers include leading EV companies around the world
exit_note: Sold to Ford Motor Company November 2023

description: Electric motorcycle company based in Rwanda, focused on serving motorcycle taxi and other commercial drivers Motorcycle taxis are a primary means of transport in East Africa, where personal vehicle ownership rates are low Replacing petrol motorcycles with electric ones offers great potential to reduce carbon emissions and improve urban air quality, while increasing driver take-home pay Ampersand is the first electric motorcycle company in Africa, and has several years of experience on the ground refining technology and business model Developed an electric motorbike ecosystem, which includes a high-performance motorcycle, a smart battery pack, and a network of battery swapping stations Ampersand plans to expand to Kenya, Uganda, and other African countries

Battery Smart is the largest battery swapping network for electric vehicles in India, focusing on commercial 2 and 3-wheel vehicles. Battery swapping provides the critical infrastructure needed to decarbonize last-mile mobility, especially in densely populated Indian cities. The company’s battery-as-a-service model enables buying an electric vehicle without a battery, thereby significantly lowering upfront capital costs and promoting wider adoption. Meanwhile, the convenient 2-min battery swap greatly improves driver economics by reducing charging downtime and providing virtually limitless range. Battery Smart partners with local businesses to set up a dense network of battery swapping stations, allowing the company to remain asset-light and operationally efficient. In just three years, the company has built a stronghold in Northern India, with presence in 14 cities and over 20k drivers and 500 partner stations on its network.

BetterFleet is a comprehensive EV fleet management platform designed to support the full lifecycle of fleet electrification, from initial planning and vehicle procurement to daily operations and depot optimization. The global commercial EV fleet market—particularly for municipal buses and other fixed-route, high-utilization vehicles—is accelerating due to tightening emissions regulations and strong cost advantages. Yet, operators face significant complexity in planning routes, optimizing charging, and maintaining performance at scale. Existing fleet tools are not built for EVs and fail to account for critical variables like charging constraints, battery degradation, and energy costs. BetterFleet’s software, built specifically for electric fleets, uses AI/ML to model route feasibility, predict energy needs, and optimize operations based on real-world usage patterns. BetterFleet is already working with major fleet operators and government transit agencies globally. By reducing planning risk, increasing uptime, and enabling smarter capital allocation, the platform is positioned to unlock large-scale EV adoption and support grid integration through coordinated charging and energy management.

Bluon is the embedded data and AI platform for the HVAC-R industry, serving contractors, technicians, distributors, and facility operators. Its proprietary, brand-agnostic equipment database and AI platform deliver accurate technical intelligence, decreasing experience requirements, reducing diagnostic errors, eliminating wrong-part orders and compressing decades of field experience into an easily accessible interface for HVAC professionals. Bluon’s platform embeds directly into contractors’ existing workflows, driving stronger technician adoption, higher retention, and faster time-to-value across the business A proprietary equipment database spanning decades of HVAC-R coverage powers an AI platform that delivers accurate, model-specific diagnostics — putting expert-level knowledge in every technician’s hands

clarostechnologies.com Claros Technologies enables low-cost destruction of Per- and Polyfluorinated Substances (PFAS) at industrial and environmental sites PFAS are synthetic compounds that resist oil, water, and grease – and do not degrade naturally. They are used at industrial sites, coated onto consumer goods, and used in fire-fighting foam Increased citizen and community concern regarding the toxicity of PFAS has resulted in increased scrutiny by the EPA, state regulation, and class-action lawsuits, with settlements surpassing $10B Claros has developed a novel, low-cost PFAS destruction technology by harnessing UV light, which operates at ambient temperature and pressure The company also offers PFAS analytical services backed by its world-class team of scientists and new test methods, capable of detecting a wide array of compounds

Floodbase is an AI-driven flood risk analytics and flood parametric insurance solutions platform, helping communities to prepare and respond to climate disasters. As a result of climate change, extreme flooding has grown 4x more frequent over the last four decades, with losses running into an average of $46B+ per event. Yet, over the past decade, 83% of such losses were uninsured, leading to a massive protection gap and exposing private and public assets to high flood risk. With its real-time flood observation technology, Floodbase uniquely enables parametric flood insurance that can cover a wide range of economic risks and provide rapid payout, necessary for recovery. It offers insurance providers a convenient one-stop solution to understand end-consumer flood exposure and launch new insurance products, thereby helping bridge the protection gap and drive broader flood resilience.

iyris.com iyris offers a platform of technologies to address climate-related challenges faced by growers today, including rising temperatures, water scarcity, and unpredictable weather patterns The company’s innovative “iyris” nanomaterial reduces heat gain in greenhouses, driving significant cost savings, improved crop yields, and higher quality produce iyris’s proprietary breeding program delivers heat, drought, and salinity tolerant tomato rootstocks, equipping growers with hardier crops for a changing climate Trials using iyris’s solutions have demonstrated up to 30% reductions in irrigation costs and yield improvements of greater than 20%

A battery cell inspection and analytics system to enable faster and safer battery manufacturing. Based on ultrasonic technology, Liminal’s solution can speed up production steps, reduce scrap rates, and predict cell performance in a fraction of the typical time. Road vehicles are responsible for 24% of GHG emissions in the U.S., and electric vehicles are projected to constitute 30% of new vehicle sales by 2030. There is increasing demand for lithium-ion batteries that power low-emission vehicles, and global manufacturers are investing in new production facilities across North America and Europe.

MITO™ is a science-based response to our mitochondrial needs, designed to strengthen the body’s immune shield at the cellular level The ready to drink beverage includes key mitochondrial nutrients Vitamin C, Zinc, CoQ10 and astaxanthin A scientifically studied blend of nutraceuticals, high-dose vitamins, and plant-based adaptogens A team of doctors and scientists formulated MITO behind leading research that establishes functional dosages of key ingredients

poseidonos.com Poseidon tackles the growing threats of warm water, pests, and algae blooms in near-shore salmon farms, ensuring healthier fish and a sustainable future for aquaculture Poseidon’s Life Support System surpasses outdated solutions by delivering high-oxygen water to fish at significantly lower fuel costs The company’s low-pressure, variable-rate compressors and oxygenation units boast 75% cost savings and double the effectiveness compared to traditional methods Poseidon’s technologies empower salmon farmers worldwide, including industry giants in Canada, Chile, Scotland, and Australasia, to cultivate larger, healthier fish

Revalue Nature accelerates development of high-quality, nature-based carbon projects in tropical forests Natural climate solutions could provide one third of the CO2 mitigation needed by 2030; however, carbon markets have historically been plagued with uneven project quality, leading to a lack of trust and a reputational risk to credit buyers Revalue nature provides a comprehensive toolkit and support for project operators, ensuring integrity, transparency, and resilience Superior technology brings precision and integrity to all stages of carbon projects (e.g., site assessment to monitoring), leading to 1) more successful projects, 2) greater trust in the market, and 3) scale Revalue’s first project, Ruvuma Wilderness, is a partnership with Carbon Tanzania to reduce risk of deforestation in the region; it is set to become one of the largest REDD+1 projects in Eastern Africa.

Electric bicycle manufacturer based in California with a portfolio of high quality, value-oriented commuter bikes and which is experiencing rapid growth E-bike sales grew 240% between 2020 and 2021 – and are projected to grow over 10% per year globally The transportation sector accounts for 28% of total US carbon emissions The range and convenience of e-bikes makes them viable car-replacement solutions for many urban and suburban commutes The company addresses a core need in the e-bike market – a high quality, reliable bike at a price point that makes it attractive to many consumer groups

SANA (formerly The Real Coconut) makes premium, certified organic, grain-free and dairy-free packaged food products Products feature nutrient dense ingredients that come from low-impact crops, including coconut, plantain, and cassava SANA’s grain-free products meet growing market demand for sustainable, healthful, plant-based foods Products are available in over 5,000 stores across the U.S. and Canada

Shoreline’s software enables more efficient and effective wind project design, construction, and operations/maintenance Over the next decade, an additional 235 GW of offshore wind capacity is projected to be added globally, bringing total installed capacity to 270GW by 2030 The global offshore wind power market has grown an average 22% per year from 1 GW installed in 2011 to 6.1 GW in 2021 The company addresses a core need for the wind industry at large – a comprehensive set of simulation and optimization tools that can help lower project costs for the sector. Shoreline counts the majority of large offshore wind developers as customers for its software.

Shipping logistics technology and services company that is revolutionizing the global shipping supply chain Repositioning empty shipping containers accounts for 20% of all container traffic – $10B-$15B per year in wasted expense SynchroNet’s proprietary container matching platform increases efficiency and profitability, and significantly reduces carbon emissions

Innovative waste-to-energy project developer that converts garbage and biomass into clean syngas for use in power generation Proprietary gas cleaning technology and proven system components enable better environmental performance and dramatically reduced capital costs Potential to dominate the global market for small/medium-size waste-to-energy projects Currently developing global pipeline of projects with initial concentration of projects in Southeast Asia

First in the textile industry circular fashion platform that rewards customers for buying sustainably and recycling responsibly using a proprietary digital wallet The direct-to-consumer flagship brand offers organic, affordable, and 100% recyclable basics clothing Rapid adoption from young Millennial and Gen Z consumers, and industry-leading retention Existing fashion brands are struggling to meet growing consumer pressure for sustainability, authenticity, and transparency The fashion industry is the third highest polluting industry, responsible for 10% of global carbon emissions and 50B garments disposed of each year

Software platform that provides easy, economical, and instant workplace flexibility for corporate customers Offers a global network of thousands of desk, meeting room, and workspace options for users Significant potential to reduce commuting and associated pollution by facilitating workspace flexibility Improves utilization of co-working spaces, reduces the time and energy expended on commuting, and improves employee satisfaction Fast-growing networks of spaces and corporate users

Provides fully electric motorcycles and battery-swapping infrastructure for Latin America’s rapidly growing delivery and ride-hailing markets. Serves a network of professional drivers who cover 100+ miles daily across major urban centers like São Paulo. Offers an all-in subscription model that includes the motorcycle, battery swaps, and maintenance—removing barriers to EV adoption. Drivers save on average 30% in operating costs compared to gasoline motorcycles while reducing emissions and noise pollution. Positioned to lead the electrification of Brazil’s 1.5 million delivery drivers and capture a share of the $25 billion two-wheeler mobility market.

Vibrant Planet’s software improves landscape-scale land management planning, execution, and monitoring – for example, improving wildfire risk management or accelerating forest restoration by facilitating decision making in complex, multi-stakeholder situations In 2022, the U.S. federal government will spend $7.4B on wildfire & forest health; recently announced initiatives target over $30B in proactive fire management to curb the devastating impact of forest fires Vibrant Planet has early buy-in from the US Forest Service and will soon offer a unique carbon market solution that combines multiple data sources to improve the planning and associated outcomes of prescriptive carbon sequestration practices The company joins a strong technical team with Silicon Valley tech veterans working alongside experienced fire management scientists

ZeroAvia is the leader in zero-emission, hydrogen-electric aviation solutions The company’s hydrogen fuel cell powertrain replaces jet fuel-powered engines in existing aircrafts Hydrogen-electric powertrains offer operators a lower total cost of ownership compared to traditional engines The company is initially focused on small commuter and cargo aircraft There is growing pressure on the aviation industry to reduce GHG and other emissions
